name: HyprRipple
author: jgarza
description: Material Design ink ripples drawn by Hyprland itself, in your theme's accent colour: on clicks, taps, focus changes and workspace switches. Six presets: Classic, Ring, Sparkle, Negative, Water, Prism. After adding, run ./install in the plugin folder to build the native plugin. Settings: Omarchy menu > Style > HyprRipple.
